common.tagline: Every Concern Matters. Every Voice Deserves Action.
common.requiredMark: Required fields are marked with an asterisk.
common.emergencyShort: Non-emergency service grievances only. For a medical emergency, contact hospital staff immediately.

landing.heroTitle: Your Voice. Your Hospital. Your Right.
landing.heroLead: Report a non-emergency hospital service problem by phone or at the help desk — no smartphone needed. Every grievance gets a reference number you can track until it is resolved.
landing.noSmartphoneText: Call the hospital grievance line from any phone. A help-desk operator can also register the grievance on your behalf.
landing.emergencyText: This platform handles non-emergency service grievances only. For an emergency, contact hospital staff or call 108 immediately.
landing.howLead: Four simple steps from your concern to an authorised closure.
landing.step1Text: Call the grievance line or visit the hospital help desk. Speak in Kannada or English.
landing.step2Text: Receive a unique complaint reference ID for your acknowledgement.
landing.step3Text: The complaint is categorised, routed to the responsible department and assigned to an officer.
landing.step4Text: Check the status any time with your ID. Pending complaints are followed up and escalated.
landing.categoriesLead: Service issues inside a government hospital — not medical advice or emergencies.
landing.voiceTitle: Speak. We will write it down.
landing.voiceLead: Our IVR line guides you in Kannada: choose a language, describe the issue, and confirm the transcript. If speech recognition is unsure, a help-desk operator takes over.
landing.voicePoint3: Assisted registration fallback at the help desk
landing.voicePoint4: SMS acknowledgement only with your consent
landing.languageLead: The interface works in Kannada and English, with large touch targets, plain language and keyboard access. Language can be changed at any time without losing your form.
landing.languagePoint3: Works on a shared help-desk tablet
landing.transparencyLead: Every status change is recorded with a timestamp and the responsible officer. Complainant details are never shown publicly.
landing.transparencyPoint3: Private contact details never shown in tracking
landing.ctaLead: Register a grievance in under two minutes, or call the grievance line from any phone.
landing.footerAbout: A public grievance and service monitoring platform for government hospitals. Non-emergency service issues only.
landing.footerDisclaimer: Prototype for SOLVATHON 2026. Demo data is synthetic. Live telephony and SMS require provider credentials.
landing.helplineNote: Toll-free demonstration number — live calling is enabled when a telephony provider is configured.

register.title: Register a grievance
register.lead: Tell us about a hospital service problem. It takes about two minutes. Fields marked * are required.
register.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: The prescribed tablets were not available at the pharmacy counter on Monday morning.
register.descriptionHint: At least 10 characters. You can write in Kannada or English.
register.departmentAuto: Let the hospital route it automatically
register.phoneHint: Only used to update you about this complaint, if you consent.
register.consentLabel: I agree to be contacted about this complaint
register.emergencyLabel: I confirm this is not a medical emergency *
register.emergencyError: Please confirm this is a non-emergency service issue.
register.review: Your complaint will be sent to the hospital grievance desk and given a reference ID.
register.successLead: Please keep this reference ID. You can use it to track the status at any time.
register.ackNote: An SMS acknowledgement is sent only if you provided a number and consented to contact.
register.assistedLead: Register a grievance on behalf of a visitor at the help desk. Read the details back before submitting.
register.readBack: I have read the details back to the complainant and they are correct.
register.readBackError: Please confirm you have read the details back to the visitor.
register.errorGeneric: The grievance could not be registered. Please check the details and try again.

track.title: Track your complaint
track.lead: Enter the complaint reference ID from your acknowledgement. Only status information is shown publicly.
track.notFound: No complaint found for this reference ID. Check the ID on your acknowledgement and try again.
track.timelineNote: Public updates only. Complainant details and internal notes are never shown.
track.helpText: Lost your ID? Call the hospital grievance desk with your approximate submission date.
track.privacyNote: Your name, phone number and internal hospital notes are not visible here.

voice.title: Voice-based grievance reporting
voice.lead: Speak your issue in Kannada or English. We will show the transcript for you to confirm before anything is submitted.
voice.demoBanner: Demo mode: no telephony or speech provider credentials are configured. This screen simulates the IVR journey. Real phone calls, Kannada speech-to-text and spoken acknowledgements require provider settings in the backend environment.
voice.liveBanner: Live IVR is configured. Calls to the grievance line create complaints automatically.
voice.recording: Listening… speak clearly about the hospital service issue
voice.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Please try again, or type the complaint below.
voice.unsupported: Live microphone recognition is not available in this browser. Use the text box below, or call the grievance line from a phone.
voice.lowConfidence: The transcript confidence is low. Please review and correct the text before submitting.
voice.manualHint: Edit or type the complaint exactly as it should be recorded. The original language is preserved.
voice.successLead: Read this reference ID back to the caller. It is also the ID used for tracking.
voice.ivrNote: For callers without a smartphone, the same journey runs over the hospital's IVR line, with announcements in Kannada and English.
voice.failure: The call could not be completed. Nothing was submitted.
voice.startError: The demo call could not be started. Check that the backend is running.
voice.consentLabel: Caller consents to an SMS acknowledgement

login.title: Staff sign in
login.lead: Hospital grievance management for administrators, department officers and help-desk operators.
login.demoNote: Synthetic accounts for the SOLVATHON demo. Use these to explore each role.
login.securityNote: Staff actions are role-based and recorded in the audit log.

dashboard.title: Hospital overview
dashboard.greetingSub: Here is how grievance management is progressing at {{hospital}}.
dashboard.trendSub: Received and resolved complaints over the last {{days}} days
dashboard.emptyText: Registered grievances will appear here with live counts, trends and follow-up alerts.
dashboard.noOverdue: No overdue complaints. Every active case is within its follow-up threshold.
dashboard.noPending: No pending complaints in this view.
dashboard.chartsUnavailable: Not enough data to draw this chart yet.

complaints.title: Complaint management
complaints.lead: Search, filter and act on grievances within your permitted scope.
complaints.searchPlaceholder: Search by reference ID or complaint text
complaints.emptyText: Try clearing filters or searching a different reference ID.
complaints.emptyAll: No complaints have been registered yet.

detail.translationNote: Automatically generated. Always check the original language text.
detail.timelineSub: Every status change, assignment, note and escalation
detail.statusNoteHint: Record what has been done. This is stored in the complaint history.
detail.resolutionHint: Required when resolving or closing the complaint.
detail.noTransitions: No further status changes are available for your role.
detail.notePlaceholder: Describe the action taken, findings or next step…
detail.noteSuccess: Note added to the complaint history.
detail.notFound: This complaint does not exist or is outside your permitted scope.
detail.conflict: This status change is not allowed from the current state.
detail.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
detail.detailError: The complaint could not be loaded.

officer.title: Officer workspace
officer.lead: Complaints routed to {{department}} or assigned to you.
officer.queueSub: Oldest first — action is due on the flagged cases
officer.empty: No complaints assigned to you yet
officer.emptyText: New complaints routed to your department will appear here.

followups.title: Follow-up and escalation
followups.lead: Complaints that need attention. Thresholds are configured by the hospital administrator.
followups.thresholdNote: Follow-up after {{followup}} hours · escalate after {{escalation}} hours. These are configurable demo values, not statutory deadlines.
followups.pendingSub: Active complaints still within the follow-up threshold
followups.overdueSub: Active complaints beyond the follow-up threshold
followups.reasonPlaceholder: For example: no action recorded for five days.
followups.reminderSuccess: Reminder recorded and notified to the responsible officer.
followups.emptyText: Complaints appear here when they cross the configured follow-up threshold.

reports.title: Reports and analytics
reports.lead: Service performance across categories, departments and status.
reports.summarySub: Based on complaints in the selected hospital
reports.notResolved: Resolved + closed complaints as a share of all complaints.
reports.emptyText: Analytics will populate as complaints are registered.

settings.title: Settings and administration
settings.lead: Manage hospital routing, staff access, follow-up thresholds and audit history.
settings.thresholdLead: Set when active complaints become pending and when they should be escalated. These are prototype configuration values agreed with the hospital, not government deadlines.
settings.thresholdError: Escalation must be greater than or equal to the follow-up threshold.
settings.deptLead: Complaints route to these departments through category rules.
settings.catLead: Set the default department for each category. Keyword hints guide automatic categorisation.
settings.usersLead: Administrators see all complaints; officers see their department; operators see their own registrations.
settings.auditLead: Security and administration relevant actions, newest first.
settings.notifLead: SMS is used only when a provider is configured. Simulated messages are recorded as simulated, never as delivered.

errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check that the backend is running and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this.
errors.notFoundLead: The page you are looking for does not exist. Use the links below to continue.
